event: Nala's well is empty, but the currents aren't hers to spend. She reaches for all of them at once.

memory.fact: A knot costs none of her own mana; the currents are raw, not lent into a weave.
A knot costs none of her own mana; the currents are raw, not lent into a weave.

event: Blue off the brook, green from the beech roots. She drags every thread within reach in.

memory.fact: A Legend Mana Weaver can drag every raw current within reach into one knot at a chosen spot.
A Legend Mana Weaver can drag every raw current within reach into one knot at a chosen spot.

event: She doesn't weave them. She knots them, tight and shapeless, right on the woman's shield.
The colors fight in her grip. Her skull throbs, and her hands shake with holding them.

changes.note: Holding the knotted currents strains Nala

memory.fact: Knotted currents fight her grip; holding the knot strains her, as a pull past the lending does.
Knotted currents fight her grip; holding the knot strains her, as a pull past the lending does.
Clashing colors knotted with no weave's shape fight each other and burst.
Clashing colors knotted with no weave's shape fight each other and burst.

event: She lets go.
The knot bursts with a boom that rolls down the brook. The shield tears apart like wet paper.

memory.fact: A knot tied on a mage's shield tears the shield's weave apart as it bursts.
A knot tied on a mage's shield tears the shield's weave apart as it bursts.
A knot tied on a mage's shield tears the shield's weave apart as it bursts.

event: The woman is flung against her hut wall. Both wolves tumble yelping through the bracken.

memory.fact: The burst strikes as a crushing blow at the knot's heart, and heavy within five paces of it.

event: The rot mist blows away with the blast, and clean air pours into the clearing.

memory.fact: The burst blows any mist or working hung on the currents away with it.
The burst blows any mist or working hung on the currents away with it.

event: [New skill acquired – Current Knot.]

changes.note: The System grants Current Knot at Basic

memory.fact: Her first knot that bursts earns: [New skill acquired – Current Knot.]
Her first knot that bursts earns: [New skill acquired – Current Knot.]

event: [Current Knot – At [Basic] level, knot raw currents together until they burst.]

memory.fact: [Current Knot – At [Basic] level, knot raw currents together until they burst.]
[Current Knot – At [Basic] level, knot raw currents together until they burst.]

event: The woman drags herself up, bloody-mouthed, and spits a word. Black force slams into Nala's chest.

memory.fact: Her crushing working is a crushing blow; she spends it once, when first brought under half health.

event: Nala's legs go. She hits the frozen ground, and the sky tilts.

changes.note: The woman's black force strikes Nala down

event: The wolves are on her, teeth in her arm, before the woman snaps a word and they back off.

memory.fact: She struck Nala down with black force, then called off the wolves biting Nala's arm.
She struck Nala down with black force, then called off the wolves biting Nala's arm.
She struck Nala down with black force, then called off the wolves biting Nala's arm.

event: Nala can't rise. She can barely lift her head.
The woman stands over her, breathing hard. Down the brook, the boom still echoes.

memory.fact: The knot's burst boomed down the brook; she knows the noise will bring folk from the south road.
The knot's burst boomed down the brook; she knows the noise will bring folk from the south road.

event: "The Lantern will hear of you, holy one."

memory.fact: Going, she says to the spent girl: 'The Lantern will hear of you, holy one.'
Going, she says to the spent girl: 'The Lantern will hear of you, holy one.'
Going, she says to the spent girl: 'The Lantern will hear of you, holy one.'

event: She pries up her hearthstone, stuffs a stone and a sheaf of notes into her shawl, and runs.

memory.fact: Hurt and unmasked, she leaves Nala spent, prises up her hearthstone, and flees for the Hollow.
Hurt and unmasked, she leaves Nala spent, prises up her hearthstone, and flees for the Hollow.
Nala saw her lift her hearthstone, take a stone and notes, and flee south over the brook.
Nala saw her lift her hearthstone, take a stone and notes, and flee south over the brook.
Nala saw her lift her hearthstone, take a stone and notes, and flee south over the brook.

event: The wolves lope after her, south over the brook, into the deep wood. The clearing goes quiet.

memory.fact: Brought to a third of her health, she breaks and flees for the Hollow, her wolves covering her.

event: Nala lies spent on the cold ground. In four bites, the blight creeps.

memory.fact: On day ten the hut wolves bit Nala four times, blighting every bite.
On day ten the hut wolves bit Nala four times, blighting every bite.

event: Half an hour passes. Her well gives back a trickle. Then footsteps crunch up the brook.

changes.note: Nala's well gives back a trickle as she lies spent
Half an hour's stillness gives Nala back a little

memory.fact: Struck down on day ten, Nala lay spent half an hour before her well gave back a trickle.
Struck down on day ten, Nala lay spent half an hour before her well gave back a trickle.

event: A tiny soot-grimed old woman pushes through the bracken: Edda Crane. "Gods, girl. What boomed?"

changes.note: Mana Weaver's telling uses this turn

memory.fact: Hearing the boom from her clearing, Edda Crane comes up the brook within half an hour to look.
